docs.summary: The base of the animators: owns the working [`Pose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Pose), advances playback, and pushes the result out through hooks a host engine implements, such as [`ApplyBoneTransform`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~ApplyBoneTransform).
The current pose. Model-space transforms are valid after [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~Update).
Playback speed multiplier applied to the delta time each update.
The root motion produced by the most recent [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~Update) (character space).
When true, applies [`RootMotionDelta`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~RootMotionDelta) to the engine via [`ApplyRootMotion`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~ApplyRootMotion).

members.name: ApplyBoneTransform
members.signature: protected abstract void ApplyBoneTransform(int boneIndex, in Transform3D localTransform)

docs.summary: Pushes one bone's local transform onto the engine object bound to it.

members.name: ApplyRootMotion
members.signature: protected virtual void ApplyRootMotion(in Transform3D delta)

docs.summary: Applies the per-update root motion delta to the character (called only when enabled).

members.name: Evaluate
members.signature: protected abstract void Evaluate(float scaledDeltaTime, out Transform3D rootMotionDelta)

docs.summary: Advances playback and writes the parent-space pose into [`Pose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Pose).
Advances the animation by `deltaTime` seconds and pushes the result to the engine.

members.name: ApplyFloatChannel
members.signature: protected virtual void ApplyFloatChannel(int channelIndex, float value)

docs.summary: Pushes one float channel (a blend shape weight, say) to the engine object bound to it. The default does nothing, so an engine without float channels ignores them.
Called after the primary pose is pushed each update (used to push secondary poses).
